title: Work for the executable small-bias construction
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $\ell$, the work of the executable small-bias construction is the sum of the binary-field preprocessing work at length $\ell$ and the binary-constructor traversal work on the Cartesian product of the sets of binary vectors of length $\ell$, with step cost equal to one plus the small-bias row work for dimensions $n$ and $\ell$.
